brief.business_goal: Grow paid salon accounts in January, when salon owners set up their booking for the year. The same push last January brought 121 paid salon sign-ups as Google Ads, Meta and Klaviyo report them (GA4 recorded 88 on the salon landing page; each platform counts the sign-ups it claims).
brief.objective: 174 new paid salon accounts between 5 January and 5 February 2027 (the request asked for 250; see the decision box)

audience.who: owners and front-desk managers of independent salons with 1 to 20 staff in the US, UK and Canada
audience.today: take bookings by phone, DMs and a paper or shared calendar, and lose income to no-shows
audience.we_want_them_to: start a paid Growth account in January

brief.single_message: Let clients book themselves any hour, and stop losing chairs to no-shows.

proof.fact: Salons that turned on SMS reminders cut no-shows by 31%
proof.source: Example Booking Software customer data, 2,140 salons, January to June 2026

proof.fact: Rated 4.8 out of 5 by salon owners
proof.source: 1,260 reviews on a public software review site, October 2026

offer.what: Growth plan at $29 a month for the first 3 months (normally $49)
offer.history: New Year salon push 2026 and Salon fall push 2026 ran the same 3-month Growth discount

mandatories: Show the offer end date and that the price returns to $49 a month after 3 months
Use the product name in full; never shorten it
No-show figures must name the source line above
no_gos: No 'free' wording: the offer is a discount

budget.line: $22,000 total: $18,000 working (media) and $4,000 non-working (agency fee $3,000, production $1,000)
budget.math: Reachable at $18,000 of media: 127 paid sign-ups from ads ($18,000 / $141.23) plus 47 from email (12,500 x 0.38%) = 174. The requested 250 needs a cost per paid sign-up of $88.67 ($18,000 / 203); the best comparable campaign reached $130.25, so the verdict is: needs more budget. Required working budget for 250: (250 - 47) x $141.23, rounded up = $28,700, which is $10,700 more than the brief allows.

deliverables.format: text, for the salon booking ad groups
Klaviyo template for the 'Salon leads' list
Klaviyo template, sent 7 days before the offer ends

kpis.source: Google Ads, Meta, Klaviyo, as each platform reports them

kpis.kpi: Cost per paid sign-up from ads

kpis.target: 1.30% or higher (holds the baseline; the past campaigns ran the same offer)
